title: Hyperparameters: grid, random and Bayesian search

videos.script: Every model has dials. The depth of a tree. The learning rate. How many leaves. {{dials}} The data cannot set them directly. Somebody has to try them. {{try}} This lesson tries them three ways. A grid, every combination of a short list. {{grid}} A random search, which explores the dial that matters more finely, whichever one it turns out to be. {{random}} And a Bayesian search, which looks at every result so far and decides where to try next. {{bayes}} On the validation months, the best setting looks much better than the defaults. On the test months, scored once, the gain shrinks to about a thousand reais. And the interval crosses zero. {{test}} That is the honest result of tuning on most data. A little better, with wide uncertainty. Worth doing, worth reporting plainly, and worth stopping. {{end}}
